note: List (pay-as-you-go) prices for US traffic. 'verification' per SKU: 'fetched' = read from the cited page on the as_of date; 'snippet' = number appeared in a search-result snippet citing that page (the page itself could not be opened from the research sandbox); 'unverified' = conflicting or third-party-only figures. Re-check snippet/unverified rows against the vendor page before committing to a budget. Volume and enterprise tiers are lower everywhere.

twilio/voice.note: Programmable Voice local inbound/outbound; Media Streams (WebSocket audio) is billed on top at stream_per_min. Whole-minute billing.

telnyx/voice.note: Call Control API $0.002/min plus SIP trunk minutes ($0.0032 in, $0.005 out); media streaming (WebSocket) $0.0035/min on top. 60/60 billing.

plivo/voice.note: Local US; 6-second increments. Audio streaming surcharge not found.

twilio/sip-trunk.note: Elastic SIP Trunking origination (local) / termination; snippets conflict on termination ($0.005-$0.013). For a self-run SIP media stack.

telnyx/sip-trunk.note: Elastic SIP Trunking, no channel fees. For a self-run SIP media stack (LiveKit SIP, Asterisk/FreeSWITCH).

livekit/cloud-sip.note: SIP participant minute (Ship plan) plus agent session minute $0.01; LiveKit-provided US number inbound $0.01/min instead of SIP. Plans: Build free (5k WebRTC min, 1k agent min), Ship $50/mo, Scale $500/mo.

livekit/cloud-webrtc.note: Browser/app callers: WebRTC participant minute plus agent session minute. No PSTN cost.

daily/pipecat-cloud.note: PSTN $0.018/min plus agent-1x active minute $0.01 ($0.0005 reserved); 1:1 WebRTC transport free.

webrtc/self-hosted.note: Browser/app callers on your own WebRTC/WebSocket server: no per-minute transport charge, only compute and egress.

deepgram/nova-3.note: PAYG list streaming; LiteLLM's price table lists $0.0048/min (mono) - the lower figure may be current. Bills audio sent, so VAD gating cuts the bill. <300 ms streaming latency.

deepgram/flux.note: Conversational STT with native end-of-turn detection (~260 ms); replaces a separate endpointer.

assemblyai/universal-streaming.note: $0.15/hr, but streaming is billed on wall-clock session duration, not audio sent: VAD gating does not reduce it. Unlimited concurrency. ~300 ms P50.

openai/gpt-4o-mini-transcribe.note: $1.25/1M audio-in tokens + $5/1M text-out, OpenAI's own ~$0.003/min estimate (LiteLLM table).

google/chirp-v2.note: Speech-to-Text V2 standard tier, 0-500k min; drops to $0.004/min at volume. Dynamic batch $0.003/min.

speechmatics/standard.note: $0.24/hr real-time standard after the July 2026 cut; enhanced $0.43/hr.

gladia/solaria.note: $0.75/hr self-serve; 103 ms partial / 270 ms final claimed.

selfhost/parakeet.note: NVIDIA Parakeet (or faster-whisper) on your own GPU: cost is in the compute line, shared across concurrent calls.

selfhost/faster-whisper.note: faster-whisper small/base on CPU or GPU: cost is in the compute line.

deepgram/aura-2.note: $0.030/1k chars PAYG (Growth $0.027); <200 ms TTFB. Streams raw PCM/mu-law at 8 kHz so telephony needs no transcoding.

cartesia/sonic.note: No PAYG rate: Scale plan $299/8M credits (1 credit/char); Pro plan is $50/1M. ~40-90 ms model latency claimed, ~170-190 ms measured with network.

elevenlabs/flash-v2.5.note: PAYG API $0.05/1k chars; Multilingual v2/v3 $0.10/1k. ~75 ms model latency.

openai/gpt-4o-mini-tts.note: Priced per token ($0.60/1M text-in, $12/1M audio-out), OpenAI's own ~$0.015/min; converted at 850 chars/min. 300-500 ms TTFB reported.

rime/mist-v2.note: Arcana $40/1M starter ($30 growth); Mist v3 P50 TTFA 96 ms.

inworld/tts-1.5-mini.note: Cheapest hosted neural TTS found; P90 TTFA <130 ms claimed. TTS-1.5 Max is $10/1M.

google/chirp-3-hd.note: 1M free chars/month; streaming ~200 ms vs ~800 ms non-streaming.

azure/neural.note: Snippets say $16/1M neural, $22/1M HD (Mar 2026 cut); LiteLLM lists $15/$30. 500k free chars/month.

hume/octave-2.note: Business plan overage $0.05/1k; smaller plans up to $0.15/1k.

selfhost/kokoro.note: Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0) on CPU or a shared GPU: cost is in the compute line.

selfhost/piper.note: Piper on CPU: cost is in the compute line.

claude-haiku-4-5.note: Fastest/cheapest Claude; 200K context. Prompt caching needs a >=4096-token prefix (put the FAQ/knowledge in the system prompt to cross it).

claude-sonnet-5-5.note: Current Sonnet; thinking off via {type: between_tools}; 512-token cache minimum.

claude-opus-5-5.note: Thinking cannot be disabled; use effort=low for voice.

deepinfra/llama-3.1-8b.note: Llama 3.1 8B Turbo on DeepInfra (LiteLLM table). No prompt-cache discount modelled. Quality well below Claude Haiku 4.5 for instruction following.

deepinfra/qwen3-14b.note: Qwen3-14B (Apache-2.0) hosted; Qwen3-32B is $0.08/$0.28. No prompt-cache discount modelled.

groq/llama-3.1-8b.note: Very low time-to-first-token on Groq hardware.

selfhost/qwen3-8b.note: Qwen3-8B Instruct on vLLM/SGLang needs its own 24 GB GPU (~0.5 s TTFT p50 at 64 concurrent on an A10): cost is in the compute line.

openai/gpt-realtime.note: $32/1M audio-in, $64/1M audio-out, $0.40/1M cached audio-in; converted at ~600 in-tokens and ~1200 out-tokens per minute. All inbound audio is billed (silence included) unless you gate it client-side; context re-billing pushes measured costs to $0.06-0.11/min.

openai/gpt-realtime-mini.note: $10/1M in, $20/1M out; production reports of $0.06-0.15/min once context growth is included.

google/gemini-live.note: $3/1M audio-in, $12/1M audio-out at 25 tokens/s (Vertex page). Accumulated context is re-billed every turn.

amazon/nova-2-sonic.note: $3/1M speech-in, $12/1M speech-out; tokens/s not published, assumed 25/s like Gemini. Third-party estimate ~$0.015/min.

hetzner/cx33.note: Shared vCPU, US $9.99/mo (EU EUR 8.49). Enough for a few dozen orchestrator sessions doing VAD + I/O.

daily/pipecat-cloud-agent.note: agent-1x $0.01 per active agent-minute (1 call per agent) - use compute_concurrency=1.

retell.note: Voice infra $0.055 + TTS $0.015 + a small LLM (~$0.006); ElevenLabs voices $0.040 instead of $0.015; telephony $0.015/min via Retell or BYO SIP. Silence, ringing and hold are billed.

vapi.note: Platform fee only; STT/LLM/TTS/telephony are passed through at provider prices. Silence billed.

bland.note: Start plan $0.14/connected min; Build $299/mo at $0.12; Scale $499/mo at $0.11. Includes STT/LLM/TTS/telephony.

elevenlabs/agents.note: Overage rate; LLM billed separately; you bring telephony.

twilio/conversation-relay.note: STT+TTS orchestration; voice minutes and your LLM extra.

telnyx/ai-agent.note: Includes orchestration, STT and TTS; LLM and telephony extra.
